mapper.select: SELECT f.owner_id,f.id,v.revision,f.revision AS current_revision,h.revision AS actual_head_revision,f.session_id,f.question_id,f.answer_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.kind')) AS kind, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.dimension')) AS dimension, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.coverage')) AS coverage, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.observation')) AS observation, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.condition')) AS `condition`, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.basis')) AS basis, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.limitation')) AS limitation, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.suggestion')) AS suggestion, d.id AS decision_id,d.revision AS decision_revision,d.choice AS decision_choice, (JSON_TYPE(v.content_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_LENGTH(v.content_json)=10 AND OCTET_LENGTH(v.content_json)<=131072 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.kind'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.authorLabel'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.dimension'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.coverage'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.observation'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.condition'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.basis'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.limitation'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.suggestion'))='STRING' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.citations'))='ARRAY' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(v.content_json,'$.citations'))<=6) AS metadata_valid FROM review_feedback f JOIN review_feedback_revision v ON v.owner_id=f.owner_id AND v.feedback_id=f.id AND v.revision=#{revision} LEFT JOIN review_feedback_revision h ON h.owner_id=f.owner_id AND h.feedback_id=f.id AND h.revision=f.revision LEFT JOIN review_feedback_decision d ON d.owner_id=v.owner_id AND d.feedback_id=v.feedback_id AND d.feedback_revision=v.revision AND d.revision=(SELECT MAX(x.revision) FROM review_feedback_decision x WHERE x.owner_id=v.owner_id AND x.feedback_id=v.feedback_id AND x.feedback_revision=v.revision) WHERE f.owner_id=#{owner} AND f.id=#{id}

SELECT r.owner_id,r.id,v.id AS version_id,v.version_number,r.revision AS source_revision, r.current_version_id,r.version_number AS head_version_number,h.version_number AS actual_head_version_number, r.status,v.title,v.baseline_kind,v.content_json FROM review_recollection r JOIN review_recollection_version v ON v.owner_id=r.owner_id AND v.recollection_id=r.id AND v.id=#{versionId} LEFT JOIN review_recollection_version h ON h.owner_id=r.owner_id AND h.recollection_id=r.id AND h.id=r.current_version_id WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.id=#{id}

SELECT a.owner_id,a.session_id,a.question_id,a.id AS answer_id,a.version_number AS answer_number, a.answer_condition,s.mode,s.status AS session_status, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.config_json,'$.feedbackTiming')) AS feedback_timing, (JSON_TYPE(s.config_json)='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.config_json,'$.feedbackTiming'))='STRING') AS config_valid, e.early_feedback,e.granted_at FROM training_answer a JOIN training_question q ON q.owner_id=a.owner_id AND q.session_id=a.session_id AND q.id=a.question_id JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.id=a.session_id LEFT JOIN ai_evaluation_access e ON e.owner_id=a.owner_id AND e.session_id=a.session_id AND e.question_id=a.question_id AND e.answer_id=a.id WHERE a.owner_id=#{owner} AND a.session_id=#{sessionId} AND a.question_id=#{questionId} AND a.id=#{answerId}
